text:
alex: bringing up a community HF model and hitting a weird HF->Redwood chat_template conversion issue. when a jinja block renders empty the converter collapses roles and sometimes removes separators, causing system/user to merge. repro below.

alex: repro snippet:
```json
{
  \"chat_template\": [
    {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": \"You are a helpful assistant.\"},
    {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"{{ user_prompt }}\"},
    {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": \"{% if extra_instructions %}{{ extra_instructions }}{% endif %}\"}
  ]
}
```

alex: if extra_instructions is empty the converted prompt becomes: single concatenated system+user paragraph (bad).

maya: @alex ack. i've seen this — converter treats empty render as "no element" instead of keeping role boundary. quick fix: insert a sentinel placeholder when a block can be empty, then strip the sentinel only in user-visible output if still empty.

maya: e.g. conversion rule suggestion:
```py
# pseudocode in hf_to_redwood.py
rendered = render(template, ctx)
if rendered.strip() == "":
    rendered = "<<EMPTY_BLOCK>>"
# later when assembling prompts, replace <<EMPTY_BLOCK>> with a role separator token so roles don't collapse
```

sam: also important: tokenization mismatch. we add explicit role separators like `<|system|>` and `<|assistant|>` but the model's tokenizer config.json often doesn't include them, which leads to offsets when quantizing. add to config.json: 
```json
"additional_special_tokens": ["<|system|>", "<|assistant|>"]
```

jordan: this caused a tiny but measurable quality regression on our evals when the separators were dropped mid-rollout. ran a quick eval on the chat-regression suite: baseline (no collapse) avg F1: 0.72, collapsed run: 0.65. quantized + collapsed: 0.62. worth blocking.

ci-bot: test run #482 failed: `tests/convert/test_chat_template_edgecases.py::test_empty_block_role_preserve` — assertion Error: expected role separators present.

alex: i'm going to push a small change to preserve placeholders and also update our model onboarding checklist to verify `additional_special_tokens` in the HF `tokenizer.json`/`config.json`. will ping for review.

maya: thanks. also add a unit test that injects ctrl characters in rendered block (e.g., `\u0000`), we've seen transformers' tokenizer do odd things with control chars.

jordan: for rollout plan: patch + unit tests -> canary on internal Dedicated pool -> run chat-regression/evals for 24h -> promote. if metrics stable, merge.

alex: noted. I'll open the PR and tag @maya @sam. :thumbsup:
